process_area.title: Field Sales Daily Operations, Account Coverage & Pipeline

value_stream.name: Field Sales, Outside Sales & Route-to-Market Force Management

fields.Participants: Regional Mgrs, Trade Sales (VS-11), Logistics (route — VS-06)

Automation Opportunity: - Route-optimization app; priority-aware daily-plan suggestions; auto-activity logging
Controls: - CTL-651: daily route from coverage plan; activity logged in CRM; adherence monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-11/VS-126 (CRM/CDP), W4220 (coverage), W4224 (tooling), VS-06 (route optimization)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inefficient-route risk**: Poor routing wastes field time/travel cost; mitigated by route optimization
- **Coverage-skew risk**: Reps visit easy accounts, neglect strategic; mitigated by priority-based planning + adherence (W4232)
System Touchpoints: - Mobile CRM/route (VS-11/W4224); CDP/account brief (VS-126); coverage plan (W4220)
Time Estimate: - ~15–30 min/day planning per rep; field time the rest

steps.activity: Rep/Sales Ops plan the daily route from the coverage plan (W4220), prioritizing high-value/at-risk/active-opportunity accounts, and scheduling visits within travel/time capacity
Rep optimize the route for travel efficiency (geography, traffic, cluster), align with appointments, and prepare per-account briefs (history, open opps, last visit — from CRM VS-11/CDP VS-126)
Rep execute visits, log activity/next steps in mobile CRM (W4224), and report daily activity to the manager

fields.Volume: Visits across ~5,400 B2B accounts per coverage plan

workflows.name: Customer Visit, Needs Analysis & Relationship Management

Automation Opportunity: - AI visit-brief and next-best-action suggestions (governed VS-128); auto follow-up tasks
Controls: - CTL-651 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Daily Operations, Account Coverage & Pipeline (PA-140.2).)
- CTL-651: needs/opportunities logged in CRM; commitments tracked; consultative coaching (VS-124)
Cross-references: - links to VS-11/VS-126 (CRM/CDP), VS-124 (selling), VS-43 (trade-pro), VS-137 (relationships), VS-70 (specialist)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Order-taker risk**: Reps take orders, don't discover needs; mitigated by consultative-selling skills (VS-124) and coaching
- **No-follow-up risk**: Visit commitments lost; mitigated by CRM logging + task management
System Touchpoints: - Mobile CRM (VS-11/W4224); CDP (VS-126); trade-pro (VS-43); product relationships (VS-137); selling skills (VS-124)
Time Estimate: - ~30–90 min/visit × call-frequency; majority of rep time

steps.activity: Rep conduct the visit — relationship-building, needs discovery (upcoming projects, specifications, pain points), and consultative advice (links to VS-124 selling)
Rep capture needs/opportunities in CRM (VS-11), identify cross-sell/attach (VS-137 relationships), and refer to specialists/trade-pro where relevant (VS-43/VS-70)
Rep agree next steps/actions with the customer, log commitments, and follow up — maintaining the account relationship over time

Automation Opportunity: - BOM/estimating automation; price/margin guardrails; quote-generation from CRM
Controls: - CTL-651 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Daily Operations, Account Coverage & Pipeline (PA-140.2).)
- CTL-651: estimates reviewed; discount within approval (VS-16/VS-118); quote validity tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-09/VS-66 (estimating), VS-57/VS-16 (pricing), VS-11 (CRM), VS-118 (pricing integrity), W4228 (opportunity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Estimate-error risk**: Wrong quantities/specs → margin loss/delivery failure; mitigated by estimating tools + review
- **Margin-leak risk**: Unapproved discounting; mitigated by price-approval workflow (VS-16/VS-118)
System Touchpoints: - Estimating tools (VS-09/VS-66); pricing (VS-57/VS-16); CRM opportunity (VS-11); pricing integrity (VS-118)

steps.activity: Rep/Estimating gather project requirements (bill of materials, quantities, specs, timeline), from the customer/site, using estimating tools (links to VS-09/VS-66 estimating)
Rep/Pricing build the quote (BOM, pricing — trade/project price links to VS-16, margin, validity), apply approval for discount (links to VS-16 credit/price approval, VS-118 pricing integrity)
Rep present the quote to the customer, negotiate, capture outcome in CRM (VS-11 → opportunity W4228), and convert to order on acceptance (W4229)

fields.Participants: Regional Mgrs, Trade Sales (VS-11), Key Accounts (VS-107), Finance/Forecast (VS-17.4/VS-127)

Automation Opportunity: - CRM pipeline automation; AI forecast-assist (governed VS-128); forecast-accuracy analytics
Controls: - CTL-651 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Daily Operations, Account Coverage & Pipeline (PA-140.2).)
- CTL-651: pipeline reviewed weekly; forecast accuracy tracked; fed to S&OP (VS-127)
Cross-references: - links to VS-11 (CRM), VS-127 (S&OP), VS-101 (MFP), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-28 (analytics), VS-128 (AI forecast)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pipeline-rot risk**: Stale/inflated opportunities distort forecast; mitigated by weekly review + stage discipline
- **Forecast-error risk**: Bad forecast disrupts supply/financial plan; mitigated by accuracy tracking + S&OP link (VS-127)
System Touchpoints: - CRM pipeline (VS-11); S&OP/demand (VS-127); MFP (VS-101); finance/forecast (VS-17.4); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Rep manage opportunities in CRM (VS-11) — stage, probability, value, close date, next step — and keep pipeline current/accurate
Regional Mgr/Sales Ops review pipeline (weekly), coach reps on stuck/at-risk deals, and validate forecast accuracy vs actual (links to VS-127 S&OP demand feed)
Sales Ops consolidate the B2B forecast, feed demand/sales planning (VS-127/VS-101), and report pipeline health/coverage to leadership (W4233)

fields.Volume: B2B orders (subset of ~3,500 AR invoices/month across ~5,200 trade + 200 corporate accounts; ecommerce links VS-10)

workflows.name: Field Order Capture, Pricing & Fulfillment Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile order entry from quote; real-time credit/availability check; delivery auto-scheduling
Controls: - CTL-651: credit check before order (VS-16.1/VS-68); price within approval; availability confirmed
Cross-references: - links to VS-11/VS-16 (order), VS-16.1/VS-68 (credit), VS-05 (inventory), VS-06/VS-74 (delivery), VS-07 (store)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit-risk**: Order to an over-limit/delinquent account; mitigated by credit check (VS-16.1/VS-68)
- **Fulfillment-failure risk**: Promised delivery not met; mitigated by availability check + delivery coordination
System Touchpoints: - Mobile order entry (VS-11/VS-16); credit (VS-16.1/VS-68); inventory (VS-05); delivery (VS-06/VS-74); store (VS-07)

steps.activity: Rep capture the order in mobile CRM/ERP (VS-11/VS-16) — items, qty, price (trade/project), delivery — from the accepted quote, checking availability (VS-05)
Rep/Credit check trade-credit (limit/standing links to VS-16.1, VS-68 trade-credit-risk), apply price approval (W4227), and confirm order to the customer
Rep coordinate fulfillment (DC/store allocation, delivery scheduling links to VS-06/VS-74 jobsite delivery), track to delivery, and confirm satisfaction

fields.Owner: Field Sales / Bid Manager / Key Accounts (VS-107)
fields.Participants: Bid team, Key Accounts (VS-107), B2G (VS-46), Legal (VS-100.3), Surety/Bond (VS-116), Pricing (VS-16)
fields.Trigger: Public/competitive tender (B2G links to VS-46, developer/contractor bid); spec opportunity

Automation Opportunity: - Bid/no-bid scoring; proposal-content reuse (VS-137); bid-deadline/compliance tracking
Controls: - CTL-651 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Daily Operations, Account Coverage & Pipeline (PA-140.2).)
- CTL-651: bid/no-bid discipline; tender ABC/competition-compliant (VS-86.3/VS-129); bond secured (VS-116)
Cross-references: - links to VS-46 (B2G), VS-116 (surety/bond), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-129 (competition), VS-16 (pricing), VS-66 (spec/design), VS-86.3 (ABC)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bid-cost risk**: Costly bids with low win-rate; mitigated by bid/no-bid discipline
- **Compliance risk**: Tender irregularity (B2G, competition, ABC); mitigated by Legal/competition review (VS-100.3/VS-129/VS-86.3)
System Touchpoints: - B2G/tender (VS-46); surety/bond (VS-116); legal (VS-100.3); pricing (VS-16); competition (VS-129); design/spec (VS-66)

steps.activity: Field Sales/Bid decide bid/no-bid (strategic fit, winnability, capacity, margin, ABC/competition links to VS-86.3/VS-129), and assemble the bid team
steps.r: Field Sales / Bid Mgr / Key Accounts

steps.activity: Bid team prepare the tender (technical proposal, pricing, surety/bond links to VS-116, compliance/legal VS-100.3, B2G requirements VS-46), and submit by deadline

Field Sales pursue specification (getting BuildRight products specified by architects/designers — links to VS-66 design services), manage the bid outcome, and transition wins to delivery (VS-11/VS-74)

fields.Owner: Field Sales Rep / Merchandising (VS-01) / Sample Mgmt (VS-62)
fields.Participants: Merchandising (VS-01), Sample Mgmt (VS-62), Trade Specialists, Logistics (VS-06)
fields.Trigger: Customer need for sample/demo; jobsite merchandising support

Controls: - CTL-651 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Daily Operations, Account Coverage & Pipeline (PA-140.2).)
- CTL-651: samples tracked/recovered (VS-62); demo skills certified (VS-124)
Cross-references: - links to VS-62 (sample mgmt), VS-01 (merchandising), VS-06 (logistics), VS-09 (demos), VS-124 (selling), VS-137 (content)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sample-loss risk**: Samples not returned/ tracked; mitigated by sample inventory (VS-62)
- **Ineffective-demo risk**: Demo doesn't advance the sale; mitigated by demo skills (VS-124)
System Touchpoints: - Sample mgmt (VS-62); merchandising (VS-01); logistics (VS-06); demos (VS-09); selling (VS-124); content (VS-137)

steps.activity: Rep/Merchandising arrange samples/demos for the customer (tile samples, product demo, mock-up) to support the spec/sale decision, from sample inventory (VS-62)
steps.r: Field Sales Rep / Merchandising / Sample Mgmt

steps.activity: Rep/Logistics deliver samples/demo to the jobsite/office, conduct product demonstration (links to VS-09/VS-124), and support jobsite merchandising/display
steps.r: Field Sales Rep / Logistics / Trade Specialist

steps.activity: Rep/Sample Mgmt track sample inventory, recover/reuse samples, and measure sample-to-sale conversion (links to VS-62 analytics)

fields.Trigger: Field activity; compliance cycle; data-quality review
fields.Volume: Field activity across the force (ABC, gifts, customer data, pricing)

workflows.name: Compliance, ABC & Data-Quality in the Field

Automation Opportunity: - Gift/hospitality auto-logging; CRM data-quality scoring; ABC-threshold alerts
Controls: - CTL-651: ABC policy + gift register (VS-86.3); customer-data privacy/consent (VS-91); pricing integrity (VS-118); periodic audit
Cross-references: - links to VS-86.3 (ABC), VS-46 (B2G), VS-91/VS-126 (privacy/data), VS-118 (pricing integrity), VS-119 (ethics), VS-28.2 (data quality)
Pain Points / Risks: - **ABC-violation risk**: Kickbacks/gifts to buyers (esp. B2G) — criminal/competitive exposure; mitigated by ABC policy + logging + audit (VS-86.3)
- **Data-decay risk**: Stale/inaccurate CRM data; mitigated by data-quality governance (VS-28.2)
System Touchpoints: - ABC/gift register (VS-86.3); CRM data quality (VS-11); privacy/consent (VS-91/VS-126); pricing integrity (VS-118); ethics (VS-119)

steps.activity: Field Sales/Compliance ensure ABC compliance in the field (gifts/hospitality to buyers within policy, no kickbacks — esp. B2G/procurement buyers links to VS-86.3/VS-46), and log gifts/hospitality
Field Sales/Privacy ensure customer-data quality and privacy (accurate CRM data, consent for marketing links to VS-91/VS-126), and pricing integrity (no off-tariff discounting links to VS-118)
steps.r: Field Sales Rep / Sales Ops / Privacy

steps.activity: Field Sales/Compliance audit field compliance (sample of activity, expense, gifts), remediate, and report to governance (VS-86.3/VS-119)
